faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://tantiauniversity.com/Admission-Overview; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.

faqs.question: How does admission to Tantia University work?
faqs.answer: The university provides an admission-procedure page and programme enquiry routes. For agriculture, request a current notice confirming whether the intended application is through JET, CUET or another permitted category, together with the corresponding payable charges. Confirm the course: Use the official programme contact to confirm that the listed degree is taking applications for your intended intake. Request the intake notice: Ask for the applicable selection rules, fee breakdown and document checklist before submitting an application.

faqs.question: How can I contact Tantia University about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: 0154-2494125. Published email: admission@tantiauniversity.com. Official admissions: https://tantiauniversity.com/Admission-Overview

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. Agriculture — Agronomy; M.Sc. Agriculture — Genetics and Plant Breeding. The [courses and fees table](/university/tantia-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: When did Tantia introduce undergraduate agriculture?
faqs.answer: The faculty account dates the B.Sc. programme to 2015-16.

faqs.question: What school streams does the catalogue list?
faqs.answer: The undergraduate catalogue accepts 10+2 PCM, PCB or Agriculture; an intake-specific minimum-marks notice remains necessary.

faqs.question: Why are two historical B.Sc. fees mentioned?
faqs.answer: The 2025-26 brochure has separate JET and CUET tuition rows, INR 58,000 and INR 70,000 per year respectively.

faqs.question: Is there a training farm?
faqs.answer: The faculty describes an agriculture farm with irrigation for field technical learning.

faqs.question: Are master’s subjects included in the checked ICAR entry?
faqs.answer: The audited Faculty of Agriculture row explicitly names B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. Other advertised degrees are not added to that scope.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. Agriculture — Agronomy; M.Sc. Agriculture — Genetics and Plant Breeding. The [courses and fees table](/university/tantia-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: 4 years (8 semesters). A broad agriculture degree supported by a faculty farm and laboratory teaching resources.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. Agriculture — Agronomy at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: 2 years. One of the agricultural master’s specialisations in the university catalogue.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. Agriculture — Genetics and Plant Breeding at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: 2 years. A crop-improvement specialisation in the official master’s list.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: Official catalogue lists 10+2 PCM/PCB/Agriculture; current minimum marks were not verified.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. Agriculture — Agronomy at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: The exact intake-year subject and marks rule still needs confirmation through [the official admission route](/university/tantia-university/admission-process).

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. Agriculture — Genetics and Plant Breeding at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: The exact intake-year subject and marks rule still needs confirmation through [the official admission route](/university/tantia-university/admission-process).

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: ₹58,000 / year · 2025-26. Historical JET tuition row: INR 58,000/year; CUET row: INR 70,000/year. Admission INR 4,650 and processing INR 10,000 listed separately. Included charges: Published tuition/course fee; additional charges must be checked separately.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for M.Sc. Agriculture — Agronomy at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: ₹70,000 / year · 2025-26. Historical tuition for MScAgronomy; INR4,650 admission plus INR10,000 processing are separate. Published two-year total INR154,650. Current2026-27 applicability remains unverified. Included charges: Published programme fee; other charges are separate unless stated.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for M.Sc. Agriculture — Genetics and Plant Breeding at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: ₹70,000 / year · 2025-26. Historical tuition for MScAgriculture Genetics and Plant Breeding; INR4,650 admission plus INR10,000 processing separate. Published two-year total INR154,650. Not a2026-27 quotation. Included charges: Published programme fee; other charges are separate unless stated.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for Tantia University?
faqs.answer: Faculty of Agriculture: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 120), recorded term 2024-06-20 to 2029-06-19. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: The faculty describes an agriculture farm with irrigation for technical training. Its account also identifies classrooms, laboratories, library facilities and separate boys’ and girls’ hostels; its undated hostel price is not treated as current.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at Tantia University?
faqs.answer: Irrigated agriculture farm: The faculty identifies this as a site for field technical training. Agriculture laboratories and library: Both appear in the faculty’s infrastructure account. Soil and water testing laboratory: The university’s laboratory site identifies a testing service with named technical staff; service availability and sample arrangements require direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for Tantia University?
faqs.answer: Agriculture laboratories and library: Both appear in the faculty’s infrastructure account.
